# NIM metadata and paired container

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/nimmodel.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **curl for metadata; crane 0.22.1 for the paired image**. Registered classes: **remote**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/nimmodel/${AW_REPO}/v2/nim/metadata`

## Before connecting

- Remote nimmodel repository plus a separate Docker remote for nvcr.io.
- AW_IMAGE_REPO is that Docker repository key. Select matching resource ID and image tag from the metadata.

Authentication: Authorize metadata reads on the nimmodel repository and image reads on a separate Docker remote. AW_TOKEN is the artifactweave user token; the administrator configures any upstream NGC API key independently.

Fresh client state: Use fresh DOCKER_CONFIG and a new output archive under AW_WORK; crane has no persistent local image store.

## Configure

Registry authority includes a port when needed. AW_URL must be a bare HTTPS origin, with no path. Configuration files remain under AW_WORK.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export DOCKER_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/docker"
mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
AW_REGISTRY="${AW_URL#*://}"
```

```sh
crane auth login "$AW_REGISTRY" -u "$AW_USER" -p "$AW_TOKEN"
```

## Publish

No supported command. NIM repositories are remote-only; no publication command is provided.

## Install or resolve

Classes: **remote**. Resolve metadata and pull the corresponding image through its separately authorized Docker remote.

nim/meta/llama:1.3 is the controlled test coordinate; substitute the model and tag actually advertised by your upstream.

```sh
curl --fail --user "$AW_USER:$AW_TOKEN" "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/nimmodel/$AW_REPO/v2/nim/metadata?resourceId=nim%2Fmeta%2Fllama&tag=1.3"
crane pull --format oci "$AW_REGISTRY/$AW_IMAGE_REPO/nim/meta/llama:1.3" "$AW_WORK/model-image.tar"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **remote** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- The retained proof is metadata HTTP plus a real registry-client pull. It is not proof that the NGC CLI can be pointed at artifactweave.
- NIM metadata and Docker image caches are separate; both must be warmed before an offline transfer.
